answer: The task is infeasible. GIMP does not have built-in RAW file support and cannot open or convert RAW images without external RAW loaders (such as darktable or RawTherapee). Despite searching through GIMP's File menu, Preferences (Image Import & Export, Color Management sections), and multiple file locations, GIMP consistently displays an error message stating it requires external software to handle RAW files. Since the task explicitly requires using GIMP only, there is no way to convert the RAW image to JPEG using GIMP alone.
